personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK (Cyberpunk Neon Green variant)
personality_one_liner: An unbreakable, 100% offline neural voice assistant operating in total air-gapped privacy with glowing cyberpunk green telemetry and biometric security.

spacing.rule: Dense tactical telemetry spacing with sharp 8pt/16pt rhythm and compact HUD alignments.

do's: Rely on solid tonal surface stacking
Maintain OLED battery-friendly dark obsidian blocks
dont's: No blur or frosted glass overlays

screens.name: WakeWordMonitor
screens.purpose: Live local audio listener state, wake-word sensitivity tuning, and hardware NPU telemetry.

states.loading: Initializing local audio buffer and neural wake-word model weights...
states.empty: No ambient voice telemetry recorded. Tap mic to calibrate.
states.error: Audio hardware capture locked. Verify microphone permissions.

screens.layout: Terminal-style top status HUD, live neon waveform visualizer card, wake-word toggle with sensitivity slider, recent offline trigger logs.

screens.name: CommandTerminal
screens.purpose: Real-time command execution console with offline NLU parsing and phone hardware control toggles.

states.loading: Parsing command locally via quantized offline LLM...
states.empty: Awaiting voice command input. Speak or type instructions.
states.error: Command execution failed. Unrecognized local grammar pattern.

screens.layout: Command prompt input bar, quick action chips for device toggles (WiFi, Bluetooth, GPS, App launch), recent command execution history list with status badges.

screens.name: VoiceEnrollment
screens.purpose: Voiceprint biometric enrollment and owner voice verification calibration.

states.loading: Analyzing acoustic spectrogram for unique vocal signatures...
states.empty: No owner voiceprint enrolled. Start calibration sequence.
states.error: Acoustic mismatch detected. Please speak clearly into the primary mic.

screens.layout: Step-by-step vocal phrase prompts, live decibel meter, spectrogram animation, verification success badge.

screens.name: PrivacyDashboard
screens.purpose: Encrypted local storage inspection, zero-cloud audit logs, and hardware isolation status.

states.empty: Encrypted audit log is currently clean.
states.error: Local keychain verification error. Re-authenticate biometrics.

screens.layout: Air-gap verification badge, local storage usage gauge, zero-cloud outbound packet counter (0 bytes), audit log table.

screens.name: SystemWizard
screens.purpose: Battery optimization exemption, offline model downloader, and permission setup wizard.

states.loading: Scanning system battery policies and storage capacity...
states.empty: All permissions and offline models configured.
states.error: Battery optimization whitelist denied by OS.

screens.layout: Step cards for battery whitelist, offline NLU pack download progress, permission checklist, finalize activation CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an offline-first, cyberpunk voice assistant app named NEXUS-OFFLINE. Strictly adhere to Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK) with Neon Green (#00FF66) accents on deep obsidian surfaces (#090D0B). Use monospace labels (JetBrains Mono) and bold display headers (Space Grotesk). Ensure 100% offline NLU status indicators, wake-word engine controls, voiceprint biometric enrollment, local encryption dashboard, and battery/permission setup wizard. Implement bottom tabs for seamless navigation. Absolutely NO blue/purple AI palettes and NO emojis in system UI.
